Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

Your hand finds the familiar loop and makes room for the weapon you need next.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Your own carried inventory
Duration
Once on each of your turns, when the printed weapon-switch trigger occurs.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Passive: once on your turn, stow one held ordinary item as part of drawing a different stowed weapon for an attack. The weapon still needs the required hands. Grants no free potion use, extra inventory slot or reduced Bulk.
